    AI Overview
    Lamar Odom did not die; he is still alive. The 46-year-old former NBA star suffered a near-fatal overdose on Oct. 13, 2015, in a Nevada brothel, suffering 12 strokes and six heart attacks before slipping into a coma
    . He survived and made a recovery, but the term "death" refers to this near-death experience. 
    • 2015 Incident: Odom was found unresponsive at the Love Ranch in Crystal, Nevada, on Oct. 13, 2015.
    • Medical Crisis: He was hospitalized in a coma, on life support, with lung failure and kidney failure.
    • Recovery: He woke up after three days and went on to make a recovery.
    • Documentary: The confusion stems from the title of the Netflix documentary, Untold: The Death & Life of Lamar Odom (2026). 
    Odom now works in the wellness space, having opened drug treatment centers, as noted in the Netflix Untold documentary coverage.
